## Goal

Describe one clear outcome.

## Allowed files

- `path/to/file.md`

## Out of scope / forbidden

- No unrelated files or deletions
- No direct changes to `main`
- No secrets or confidential information
- No force push or automatic merge

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Intended file(s) changed
- [ ] Existing useful content preserved
- [ ] Links and previews checked
- [ ] PR diff reviewed by a human

## Expected handoff

Create a separate branch and (if supported) a draft PR. List changed files, actual checks, unresolved questions, and the PR or commit URL. If repository write access is unavailable, provide a copy-ready draft and state that no changes were saved.

## Additional context

Link any relevant reference or example here.
